body:
Adds `research/replicate-twin`: exact MSE and exact Student-t interval coverage for replication-deletion of a fixed twin-run budget under an AR(1) start-up transient, plus preliminary M/M/1 simulation. A single run minimises MSE; short replications undercover at the MSE-optimal deletion; batch means were not worse in this model. Updates README bullet and `site/projects.json`; `python site/build.py` prints ok (9 new tests pass).
